The number of pages is 2n, and the condition is 2n ≡ 3 (mod 7). Since 2·5 = 10 ≡ 3 (mod 7), this means n ≡ 5 (mod 7).

The smallest n > 100 with n ≡ 5 (mod 7) is 103, because 98 + 5 = 103. Check: 2·103 = 206 = 7·29 + 3, so the page count is 3 more than a multiple of 7.

- Solution 1 gives 19, which ignores n > 100.
- Solution 2 gives 112, which is not the smallest. Its claim that n = 7 works is also wrong, since 14 ≡ 0 (mod 7).
- Solution 3 gives 104, but its own formula gives (7·29 + 3)/2 = 206/2 = 103, so it made an arithmetic slip.

None of the three has the correct answer of 103.

CHOICE: NONE
